newsitem.title: UK: Recommendations on IPE gas oil contract released.
newsitem.headline: Recommendations on IPE gas oil contract released.

text.p: The International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) has published an independent review of its gas oil contract that was prompted by problems encountered in the delivery of the November 1996 contract.
The IPE is now considering the following recommendations from the review:
- The introduction of position limits in the last five days before expiry.
- The establishment of a Delivery Committee to allow speedy resolution of any delivery dispute and to ensure the physical delivery takes place.
- The establishment of a system of fines to deal with breaches of rules.
- Random checks that the seller has oil in tank and/or the removal of the seller's right to reject the buyer's five-day delivery range.

The review by energy consultant Sally Clubley is now being considered by the IPE. Industry users of the IPE are invited to submit written comments on the review by April 21 ahead of the IPE formulating proposals for changes or clarifications to its procedures in May.
